sql: SELECT firstName, lastName FROM Master WHERE birthCountry != 'USA' AND birthYear = 1990
SELECT firstName, lastName, deathYear - birthYear FROM Master WHERE shootCatch IS NULL AND deathYear IS NOT NULL
SELECT AVG(weight) FROM Master WHERE height > 72
SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master T1 JOIN Goalies T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.lgID IN ('PCHA', 'NHL') GROUP BY T1.playerID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.lgID) = 2
SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, SUM(T2.Min) / COUNT(T2.playerID) FROM Master T1 JOIN Goalies T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID GROUP BY T2.playerID ORDER BY COUNT(T2.playerID) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT nameGiven, firstNHL, firstWHA FROM Master WHERE firstNHL IS NOT NULL AND firstWHA IS NOT NULL
SELECT nameNick, lastNHL FROM Master ORDER BY CAST(height AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T3.name FROM Master T1 JOIN Goalies T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID JOIN Teams T3 ON T2.year = T3.year AND T2.tmID = T3.tmID WHERE T1.pos = 'G' AND T1.deathYear IS NOT NULL AND T1.birthCountry = 'Canada'

SELECT T1.nameGiven, T3.name, T2.year FROM Master T1 JOIN Coaches T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID JOIN Teams T3 ON T2.year = T3.year AND T2.tmID = T3.tmID WHERE T1.playerID IS NOT NULL AND T1.coachID IS NOT NULL
SELECT T1.nameGiven, CAST(SUM(T2.Min) AS REAL) / SUM(T2.GP) FROM Master T1 JOIN Goalies T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.playerID = 'aebisda01' AND T1.pos = 'G'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) FROM Master T1 JOIN AwardsPlayers T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year = 1983 AND T1.pos = 'G'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CombinedShutouts WHERE year = 1977 AND "R/P" = 'R'
SELECT COUNT(tmID) FROM Goalies WHERE year = 2005 AND ENG IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.coachID) FROM Master T1 JOIN Coaches T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T2.w > 30 AND T1.birthCountry = 'USA'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.award FROM Master T1 JOIN AwardsCoaches T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T1.birthYear = 1952
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.coachID) FROM Master T1 JOIN AwardsCoaches T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T2.year = 1940 AND T1.birthCountry = 'Toronto'
SELECT firstName FROM Master WHERE shootCatch IS NULL AND hofID IS NOT NULL AND pos = 'G'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.birthCity FROM Master T1 JOIN AwardsPlayers T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year = 1970
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) FROM Master T1 JOIN AwardsPlayers T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.award = 'All-Rookie' AND T1.birthCity = 'Toronto'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) FROM Master T1 JOIN AwardsPlayers T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.award = 'All-Rookie' AND T1.deathYear IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) FROM Master T1 JOIN AwardsPlayers T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.deathState = 'Massachussets'
